full_source_validation.offset_convention: Zero-based Unicode character offsets, end exclusive; not byte offsets.
reading_notes: For lengthy 1950.5, whole-file hash and exact span verified; the relevant subsection (n) and neighboring provisions inspected. Bulk output of the full file was truncated, so this is not a claim to have read every preceding provision.
Wrapper citations and references elsewhere in the full section were not imported into focused labels. Real excerpts have intact relevant expressions.
No live legal-currentness research performed or needed for source-bound textual labels.

contract_findings.finding: Instructions exclude source identifiers by role; criteria exclude identifiers alone categorically. Text-only CIV 1788.16 cannot establish its role.
contract_findings.recommendation: Prefer remove source wrappers in preparation and count actual body citations even when standalone. If intentionally excluding all bare identifiers, say so explicitly, document that bare body citations can be missed, and test both forms. Do not score role recognition from metadata withheld from the model.

contract_findings.finding: Cut off at Section leaves public/private source type unknown. This differs from a completed legal pointer with an unavailable target.
contract_findings.recommendation: Use INSUFFICIENT for bare truncated Section unless other supplied wording establishes its legal sense. Add a clear contrast such as Under the Civil Code, comply with Section [missing] = YES. If public legal source is assumed by default for conventional section syntax, specify and justify that input assumption rather than claiming it follows from visible text.

contract_findings.finding: Official legal guidance can be a useful lead, but official publication alone does not establish legal guidance.
contract_findings.recommendation: Include specifically named agency guidance on rights, duties, eligibility, or legal administration without judging legal force. Exclude an official gardening handbook or unrelated agency newsletter; add a close negative. The HUD example is acceptable under the intended inclusion.

contract_findings.finding: The self stratum is not inferable from text-only input. Presence is nevertheless clear.
contract_findings.recommendation: Rename stratum explicit_number unless a separate relationship demonstration supplies anchor identity. Do not report this as a model demonstration of self-target classification.

contract_findings.finding: Ordinary semantic conventions distinguish building rules from legal provision references, but this remains context-sensitive.
contract_findings.recommendation: Do not treat mere placement in a legal-research request as proof of public source. Test explicit private-context overrides of paragraph/subsection language as well as this Act. Keep genuinely ambiguous wording eligible for INSUFFICIENT.

contract_findings.finding: Blank/whitespace/missing/nonstring input should be preparation failure, not a substantive NO or model uncertainty.
contract_findings.recommendation: Validate these outside Jev and retain them separately in coverage accounting.
